ingest.note: Audio sent back to the PSTN caller must be G.711 μ-law 8 kHz.

egress.note: Inbound caller audio arrives as G.711 μ-law 8 kHz mono over the media stream WebSocket.

potholes.note: Telephony audio is narrowband μ-law 8 kHz. A decode and resample stage is mandatory before any model.
Plivo uses XML elements to start streaming; the WebSocket connects only after the XML element is processed. Handle the async bridge.
Use Dial to bridge the caller to a DID or authenticated SIP endpoint. Stop the AI media path only after the destination answers; handle Dial completion/failure so the caller is not stranded.

latency_evidence.methodology: Callsmith architecture-budget placeholder; benchmark in the deployment region before setting an SLO.

interruption.description: Stop sending audio frames to the media stream WebSocket. Plivo does not support explicit clear/flush commands.
interruption.code_hint: On interruption: stop writing to the WebSocket and flush your local outbound buffer.

hosted_option.note: Carrier/media service only; region and residency behavior remain unverified in this pack.

deployment.self_host_notes: Your media worker is self-hosted. Co-location advice remains unknown until the media-edge path is measured.
